candidate.title: Div-Seq
candidate.scope: The single Div-Seq route shown in the assigned Illumina schematic: in-vivo-EdU-labeled tissue, nuclear isolation, fluorescent tagging and FACS, followed by nuclear mRNA-to-cDNA library preparation and an indexed P5/P7 enrichment-ready fragment. Nuc-Seq/sNuc-Seq and Smart-seq2 name underlying components here; the card lists Nuc-seq and snRNA-seq as similar methods, not depicted alternatives. The disconnected far-left Single cell-to-poly(A)-RNA icon is a descriptive assay-class header, not a second experimental branch. This is a schematic-level architecture, not every experimental implementation.

states.label: Tissue labeled in vivo with EdU
features: Input preparation history is in vivo EdU pulse labeling of proliferating cells; EdU can remain associated with their progeny.
The tissue icon is the entry to the drawn experimental route.

operations.label: FACS sort
operations.description: Inspect the nuclear fluorescence and retain labeled individual nuclei for single-nucleus RNA profiling. The mRNA drawing downstream represents the RNA of these nuclei, not an RNA product made by FACS.
operations.information_effect: Enriches the profiled population using EdU-associated fluorescence while retaining per-nucleus transcript attribution.
